title: A.J. Johnson, McNeil's Southern Syncopators and Lola Bell
summary: Albert identifies pianist A.J. Johnson and the McNeil band, and blues singer Lola Bell who sang with his band.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom

blocks.x: Who did you play with in Dallas?
I don't remember, there was a client that played, I haven't been able to call his name yet, that went to Europe. He was a member that day.
And did you know Lonnie Jackson, a piano player?

And did you know Lola Bell?
